hardware: 4x NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB unified memory each)
topology: TP4 across four Sparks in a switchless RoCE ring: each node cabled to its two neighbours, two ConnectX-7 paths per cable, no switch
negotiated_link_speed: 200 Gb/s per ConnectX-7 port (4 cables, 8 RDMA paths)
quantisation: the native checkpoint, not requantized: block-32 FP8 E4M3 dense weights (a UE8M0 scale per 32x32), MXFP4 (E2M1) routed experts, BF16 router gate, indexer head weights and compressor; MXFP8 activations where DeepSeek's reference quantizes them
kv_cache_dtype: as DeepSeek's reference caches it: sliding-window KV in FP8 E4M3 with a UE8M0 scale per 32, compressed (indexed) KV in FP4 E2M1 with an E4M3 scale per 16, MXFP4 indexer keys
serving_engine: vLLM: Local Inference Lab integration/karmic-kraken-beta 19f2c20e with the spark-ds41f patch series (patch head c001cc4e, tree d11e9836); TileLang 0.1.15 kernels, DeepSeek TileKernels 2.0.0, sparknet one-shot RoCE collectives
drafter: DSpark (the checkpoint's drafter), 5 speculative tokens, greedy drafts, block rejection, adaptive verification
scheduler: max sequences 16; max batched tokens 8192; chunked prefill; asynchronous scheduling; prefix caching; CUDA graphs FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
competing_traffic: none: run inside a held lab window, the cluster otherwise idle
server_sampling_defaults: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0 for requests that set none
